# Hermes Agents Forge

> Forge turns a stated goal into a focused, validated team of Hermes agent
> profiles. Install the skill, open Hermes, type /forge.

## Install

- Skill (canonical): https://hermes-agents-forge.vercel.app/SKILL.md
  Install with: hermes skills install https://hermes-agents-forge.vercel.app/SKILL.md
- After install: open Hermes (CLI or Desktop) and type /forge

## Docs

- Start instructions for agents: https://hermes-agents-forge.vercel.app/start.md
- Skill index: https://hermes-agents-forge.vercel.app/.well-known/skills/index.json
- Source code: https://github.com/juliench82/hermes-agents-forge
  (source only — never required for activation, never cloned by the flow)

## Notes

- /forge asks for the user's goal, proposes a 3/5/7-profile team, and requests
  explicit approval before any writes.
- The website distributes the activation skill only; Hermes performs the
  onboarding locally. The site does not create agents and collects no keys.
